items.title: Elon Musk says SpaceX's Nvidia-powered orbital data center could be ready next year
items.summary: SpaceX (SPCX) launched 29 Starlink satellites this week. CEO Elon Musk also noted that the company's first Nvidia-powered (NVDA) orbital data center could launch in the fourth quarter of 2027. Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley chats with Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian and Business Insider executive editor and anchor Dan DeFrancesco about what's next for the company.
